resolutions.resolution: change spec to meet the comment in the issue
resolutions.background: The WPT test [scroll-animations/scroll-timelines/play-animation.html](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/scroll-animations/scroll-timelines/play-animation.html) has a "Playing a running animation resets a sticky start time" subtest that assumes that a running scroll-driven animation with an explicitly-set start time should reset its start time when `play()` is called:

<ydaniv> ... when you call play() you have the auto-rewind behavior, to get the scroll range relaligned ...
<estelle> are we talking about scroll driven or triggered animations?

<ydaniv> ... more important are changes on source or geometry.

<ydaniv> ... I'm happy with it
<ydaniv> dshin-moz: SGTM
